subject: maths
question: The cost of 12 pens and 7 pencils is ₹285. If the cost of a pen decreases by ₹6 and the cost of a pencil increases by ₹5, then the cost of 11 pens and 3 pencils is ₹118. What is the original cost of 2 pens and 2 pencils?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Let original cost of a pen be x and a pencil be y. Given equations: 12x + 7y = 285 and 11(x − 6) + 3(y + 5) = 118 ⇒ 11x + 3y = 169 Using cross-multiplication: x = (285 × 3 − 169 × 7) ÷ (12 × 3 − 11 × 7) = −328 ÷ −41 = 8 Substituting x in the second equation: 11 × 8 + 3y = 169 ⇒ 3y = 81 ⇒ y = 27 Original cost of 2 pens + 2 pencils = 2 × (8 + 27) = 2 × 35 = 70 **∴ The correct answer is ₹70.**
